parties.petitioner: Haryana State Industrial & Infrastructure Development Corporation Limited & Others

summary: Land acquisition compensation dispute; notifications dated 30.06.2005 and 05.03.2007 for KMP Express Highway project; High Court enhanced compensation to Rs.29.54 lakh/acre (2005) and Rs.45 lakh/acre (2007); appellants challenged excessive enhancement citing agricultural nature of land; High Court relied on builder's sale deeds (Ex. P43&P44), applied 50% cut; remanded matter previously with direction to consider land value as of 13.08.2004; rejection of belting system; landowners argued for higher compensation based on other deeds.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed in part; compensation for 2005 acquisition reduced to Rs.24.44 lakh/acre; 2007 compensation revised to reflect realistic market value considering time gap; High Court judgment modified.
